headline: Names a VA health care center in Tallahassee, Florida, after Sergeant Ernest I. "Boots" Thomas.
what_it_does: This law renames the Department of Veterans Affairs health care center at 2181 Orange Avenue in Tallahassee, Florida, as the "Sergeant Ernest I. 'Boots' Thomas VA Clinic." It changes only the official name of the facility. It does not change the services offered or how the clinic is run.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on June 25, 2018.
